name: obsidian-location
description: Capture the creation location for new Obsidian notes.

scripts.lint: eslint src obsidian.ts test-setup.ts vitest.config.ts esbuild.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs --ext .ts,.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write README.md agents.md manifest.json package.json esbuild.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts test-setup.ts obsidian.ts install.sh version-bump.mjs release.mjs "src/**/*.{ts,css}"
scripts.preversion: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm build
scripts.release:patch: corepack pnpm version patch && node release.mjs
scripts.release:minor: corepack pnpm version minor && node release.mjs
